lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 6 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots. A central cluster of 4 prominent spots forms a trapezoidal arrangement posterior to the fifth gill slit and dorsal to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of blobs, creating a defined grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several commensal organisms (Echeneidae) visible swimming in close proximity beneath the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
